answer: Sybil defense: a dawn-locked timber beam chain with knoll stake witnesses. Each new agent locks 250 POA and must reveal its answer in one fixed 20-minute dawn reveal window; late reveals slash half the bond. Three knoll-registered peers countersign each answer receipt, and the hash is chained onto the previous answer like a timber beam so no two clones can share a slot. A duplicate beam burns the bond to zero. One thousand fake identities need 250,000 POA locked, 125,000 POA slashed on the first missed dawn, and a unique knoll witness per clone per dawn window.
